en: Ganthasampayuttaduka (The Couple of States Bound by Ties and Conjoined)
Dependent on a state associated with the taints (*nigantha*), a state associated with the taints arises by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state associated with the taints, a state dissociated from the taints arises by way of the root-condition.
Dependent on a state associated with the taints, states both associated with the taints and dissociated from the taints arise...
They arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the taints (*nigaṇṭhavippayutta*), a state dissociated from the taints arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from the taints, a state associated with the taints arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the taints (*nigantha*), states that are both associated with the taints and dissociated from the taints arise by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is both associated with the taints and dissociated from the taints, a state that is associated with the taints [arises].

A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is both associated with the taintless and dissociated from the taintless, a state dissociated from the taintless arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is both associated with the taintless and dissociated from the taintless, states that are both associated with the taintless and dissociated from the taintless arise by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root-cause, nine; in the case of object, six; in the case of predominance, nine …pe… in the case of result, one …pe… in the case of non-disappearance, nine. (The full detail applies in all instances.)
